title: C27: WaveTrend dots (LazyBear WT_CROSS_LB) as triggers, 15m / 1h / 2h / 4h

what.name: WaveTrend
what.value_plain: n1 10, n2 21, wt2 = 4-bar average of wt1; overbought / oversold lines +53 / -53
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Signals
what.value_plain: buy dot = wt1 crosses up through wt2 (in the -53 zone, or anywhere); sell dot = the mirror
what.label: OURS

what.name: Hold
what.value_plain: 16 x 15m, 12 x 1h, 6 and 12 x 2h, 6 x 4h; entry at the close of the bar after the dot
what.label: OURS

what.name: Edge
what.value_plain: signal mean minus holding the same side for the same time at every bar
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: wavetrend_dots.py on Binance spot 15m from 2022 (1h/2h/4h built from it); 2024-07+ left sealed for the WaveTrend pre-reg.
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)

verdict.label: NO as a trigger: no dot type beats fees on any timeframe beyond noise; zone dots (the ones on the chart) are worse than plain dots.

why: Agrees with the older MTS WaveTrend atlas (wavetrend_2026-10-17: 4 FAIL, 5 INCONCLUSIVE, no fees) and the 30m sequence study.
Best cell: 4h any buy dot, net +0.14% over 24h, 1 SE 0.14% - one standard error, among 20 cells: luck-sized.
Use it as context (stretched / turning), never alone; a 2024-07+ check needs its own pre-registration.
